meta.name: onecli-gateway
meta.description: OneCLI Gateway: transparent HTTPS proxy that injects stored credentials into outbound calls. You MUST use this skill when the user asks you to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, create issues, check Stripe payments, or interact with ANY external service or API. Do NOT use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools. Make HTTP requests directly; the gateway injects credentials automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为外部API请求注入凭证，无需手动认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要调用多个外部API并处理认证
copy.tagline_en: Automatically inject credentials into external API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently call multiple external APIs and handle authentication

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会直接对真实 API 地址发 HTTP 请求,由网关在代理层自动注入已存凭证,它自己看不到也不经手密钥。若某个服务尚未连接,会返回一个连接链接给你。
howto.when: 当你要求读邮件、查日历、访问 GitHub 仓库等任何外部服务或 API 交互时接管;原文明确此时不要用浏览器扩展或 OAuth 命令行工具。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude makes plain HTTP requests to real API URLs; the gateway injects your stored credentials, so it never sees or handles keys. If an app isn't connected, it returns a link to connect it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to read email, check calendar, access GitHub, or interact with any external service or API. It takes over instead of browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools.
